usage_notes.primary_logo: Use the horizontal lockup on wide layouts and the stacked lockup on square/vertical placements.
usage_notes.favicon: Use icon-only assets for favicons, PWA icons, and small app badges.
usage_notes.backgrounds: Use warm ivory for light brand contexts and near-black charcoal for dark contexts.
usage_notes.svg_note: SVG files embed the high-detail PNG assets to preserve metallic and glow effects; they are not hand-vector traced.
